text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but I've got a MAJOR

hankering for sakura mochi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I crave that gentle sweetness that
permeates the
mouth and that fragrance
that heals the body!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was in the middle of my daily Bakushin,
so why?
Why is my mind flooded with
thoughts of sakura
mochi?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear that people crave sweet food
when they're
tired. Although she hasn't
noticed it herself, it
seems that the
fatigue has caught up with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be good to reconsider her race

schedule...
